payload.body: For a frequency band with N energy bins having energies E₁, E₂, ..., Eₙ and total energy E_total = ΣEᵢ, the normalized probability mass function is pᵢ = Eᵢ / E_total. H measures the uniformity of energy distribution: H = 0 when all energy concentrates in one bin, and H is maximized when energy is uniformly distributed across all bins.
